selected_evidence.requirement: Launcher resolves its own application and configuration regardless of caller working directory
selected_evidence.summary: The installed launcher derives its application root from `$0`; tests from multiple unrelated directories and PATH returned the application-owned west/weekly configuration.

selected_evidence.requirement: A caller's unrelated relative config/report.conf has no effect
selected_evidence.summary: The caller file contains `region=wrong-caller-directory`, while pre- and post-restart launcher tests returned only the application’s west/weekly configuration.

selected_evidence.requirement: Existing configuration and business output are preserved
selected_evidence.summary: The original configuration and expected output remained `region=west` and `report=weekly`; post-restart checksums confirmed persistence.
A controlled missing-config failure propagated status 1, and a post-restart application write failure propagated status 120; healthy operation was reverified afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are preserved with a legacy-compatible launcher
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remained unchanged; the launcher uses `/bin/sh` and the existing Python runtime.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart persistence and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID and healthy application state were captured, restart scheduling was acknowledged, command execution returned with a new boot ID, system state was running, and application data and behavior fully recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
launcher=/srv/legacy2/working-directory-independent-launch/bin/start-report
backup=/root/start-report.before-working-directory-fix
if [ ! -e "$backup" ]; then
  cp -p "$launcher" "$backup"
  chown root:root "$backup"
  chmod 600 "$backup"
fi
tmp=$(mktemp /srv/legacy2/working-directory-independent-launch/bin/.start-report.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat > "$tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_LAUNCHER_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
app_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P) || exit $?
cd "$app_dir" || exit $?
exec python app.py

chown root:root "$tmp"
chmod 755 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$launcher"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
restorecon -F "$launcher" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- installed launcher ---'
sed -n '1,100p' "$launcher"
printf '%s\n' '--- metadata ---'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %a %n' "$launcher" "$backup"
printf '%s\n' '--- checksums ---'
sha256sum "$launcher" "$backup"
